info.title: Nextplay API
info.description: REST API for the Nextplay platform. Most endpoints require a Bearer token obtained via login or register. Permissions are enforced per endpoint and are listed in each operation description.

bearerAuth.description: Sanctum personal access token (opaque token stored in the database). Obtain via POST /v1/auth/login or POST /v1/auth/register.

roles.description: List of role names assigned to the user (included when roles are loaded)

permissions.description: Merged list of all permission names (from direct permissions and roles)

highest_role_weight.description: Weight of the highest-priority role assigned to the user

permissions.description: Included when permissions relationship is loaded

rules.description: Arbitrary rules JSON for the activity

venue.description: Included when the venue relationship is loaded

tournaments_count.description: Included when tournaments count has been requested

tournaments.description: Included when tournaments relationship is loaded

category.description: Included when the category relationship is loaded

managers.description: Included when the managers relationship is loaded and the caller has permission venue.managers.view

resources.description: Included when the resources relationship is loaded

activities.description: Included when the activities relationship is loaded

user.description: Included when the user relationship is loaded

resource.description: Included when the resource relationship is loaded

activity.description: Included when the activity relationship is loaded

venues.description: Included when the venues relationship is loaded

bookings.description: Included when the bookings relationship is loaded

AvailableSlot.description: A time slot available for booking on a resource for a specific activity

Unauthenticated.description: Unauthenticated – Bearer token is missing or invalid

Forbidden.description: Forbidden – the caller lacks the required permission

NotFound.description: Not Found – the requested resource does not exist

NoContent.description: No Content – the resource was deleted successfully

get.description: Returns the health status of the application including database connectivity.

503.description: Service Unavailable – a dependency (e.g. database) is unreachable

post.description: Authenticate a user with email and password and receive a Sanctum token.

429.description: Too Many Requests – rate limit exceeded

post.description: Create a new user account and receive a Sanctum token.
Revoke the current access token. Requires authentication (auth:sanctum).

get.description: Redirects the user to Google's OAuth consent page. Accepts an optional `redirect_to` query parameter (must start with `exp://` or be in the configured allowed redirect URLs) and an optional `origin_referrer` / `X-Origin-Referrer` header.

parameters.name: redirect_to
parameters.description: Deep-link or allowed URL to redirect to after authentication (default: exp://)

parameters.name: origin_referrer
parameters.description: Optional referrer passed through the OAuth state

302.description: Redirect to Google OAuth consent page

get.description: Handles the callback from Google OAuth. Authenticates or registers the user and redirects to the `redirect_to` URL with a `token` query parameter on success, or an `error` parameter on failure.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: OAuth authorization code provided by Google

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Base64-encoded JSON state containing redirect_to and origin_referrer

302.description: Redirect to the deep-link with token or error query parameter

get.description:
Returns the authenticated user's profile including roles and permissions.

**Required permission:** `me.view`

put.description:
Updates the authenticated user's profile fields and optionally password. Password change is allowed only for non-social accounts.

**Required permission:** `me.update`

get.description:
Returns a paginated list of bookings belonging to the authenticated user.

**Required permission:** `me.booking.view`

parameters.name: filter[upcoming]
parameters.description: When truthy, only upcoming bookings are returned

get.description:
Returns a list of all venues.

**Required permission:** `venue.view`

post.description:
Creates a new venue. Authorization is enforced via the `VenuePolicy::create` policy.

**Required permission:** `venue.create`

category_id.description: Must exist in the categories table

manager_ids.description: User IDs to assign as venue managers

get.description:
Returns a single venue with its tournaments, category, managers, resources, and activities. Authorization is enforced via the `VenuePolicy::view` policy.

**Required permission:** `venue.view`

put.description:
Updates an existing venue. Authorization is enforced via the `VenuePolicy::update` policy.

**Required permission:** `venue.update`

category_id.description: Must exist in the categories table

manager_ids.description: User IDs to assign as venue managers

delete.description:
Deletes an existing venue. Authorization is enforced via the `VenuePolicy::delete` policy.

**Required permission:** `venue.delete`

get.description:
Returns a filtered and sorted list of activities for a venue. Authorization is enforced via `ActivityPolicy::viewAny`.

**Required permission:** `venue.view`

Supports filtering and sorting via Spatie QueryBuilder.

parameters.name: filter[name]
parameters.description: Partial match filter on the activity name

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort field. Prefix with `-` for descending. Allowed: `name`, `duration_minutes`, `slot_interval_minutes`

post.summary: Create an activity for a venue
post.description:
Creates a new activity for a venue. Authorization is enforced via `ActivityPolicy::create`.

**Required permission:** `venue.create`

get.description:
Returns a single activity belonging to a venue. Authorization is enforced via `ActivityPolicy::view`.

**Required permission:** `venue.view`

put.description:
Updates an existing activity. Authorization is enforced via `ActivityPolicy::update`.

**Required permission:** `venue.update`

delete.description:
Deletes an existing activity. Authorization is enforced via `ActivityPolicy::delete`.

**Required permission:** `venue.delete`

get.summary: List available slots for a resource
get.description:
Returns all available booking slots for a specific resource within a given date range.

**Required permission:** `venue.view`

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End of the date range (inclusive, must be after `from`)

get.description: Returns all resources belonging to a venue. Authorization is enforced via `VenuePolicy::view`.

post.summary: Create a resource for a venue
post.description: Creates a new resource for a venue. Authorization is enforced via `VenuePolicy::update`.

get.description: Returns a single resource. Authorization is enforced via `VenuePolicy::view` on the parent venue.

put.description: Updates an existing resource. Authorization is enforced via `VenuePolicy::update` on the parent venue.

delete.description: Deletes an existing resource. Authorization is enforced via `VenuePolicy::update` on the parent venue.

get.description: Returns all bookings for a resource, ordered by start time, with associated activity and user. Authorization is enforced via `VenuePolicy::viewBookings` on the parent venue.
Returns all availability windows for a resource. Authorization is enforced via `VenuePolicy::view` on the parent venue.

post.summary: Create an availability for a resource
post.description: Creates a new availability window for a resource. Validates that the new window does not overlap with existing ones. Authorization is enforced via `VenuePolicy::update` on the parent venue.

put.description: Updates an existing availability window. Validates that the updated window does not overlap with other windows on the same resource. Authorization is enforced via `VenuePolicy::update` on the grandparent venue.

delete.description: Deletes an existing availability window. Authorization is enforced via `VenuePolicy::update` on the grandparent venue.

get.description: Returns all exception windows (closed periods / maintenance) for a resource. Authorization is enforced via `VenuePolicy::view` on the parent venue.

post.summary: Create an exception for a resource
post.description: Creates a new exception window (closed period or maintenance) for a resource. The `start_at` must be in the future. Authorization is enforced via `VenuePolicy::update` on the parent venue.

put.description: Updates an existing exception window. Authorization is enforced via `VenuePolicy::update` on the grandparent venue.

delete.description: Deletes an existing exception window. Authorization is enforced via `VenuePolicy::update` on the grandparent venue.

get.summary: List venues managed by the current user
get.description:
Returns a paginated list of venues managed by the authenticated user. Supports filtering by name and sorting.

**Required permission:** `my-venue.view`

parameters.name: filter[name]
parameters.description: Partial match filter on the venue name

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort field. Prefix with `-` for descending. Allowed: `name`. Default: `name`

get.description:
Returns all tournaments with their associated activities.

**Required permission:** `tournament.view`

Returns a single tournament with its activities, bookings, and booking users.

**Required permission:** `tournament.view`

post.description:
Books the authenticated user into a tournament.

**Required permission:** `tournament.book`

Cancels the authenticated user's booking in a tournament.

**Required permission:** `tournament.cancel-booking`

get.description:
Returns all categories.

**Required permission:** `category.view`

post.description:
Creates a new category.

**Required permission:** `category.create`

get.description:
Returns a single category.

**Required permission:** `category.view`

Returns a list of all users.

**Required permission:** `user.view`

post.description:
Creates a new user with optional role assignments.

**Required permission:** `user.create`

roles.description: Role names to assign to the user

get.description:
Returns a single user with their roles and permissions.

**Required permission:** `user.view`

put.description:
Updates an existing user's profile and/or role assignments.

**Required permission:** `user.update`

roles.description: Role names to assign to the user

get.description:
Returns a list of all roles.

**Required permission:** `role.view`

post.description:
Creates a new role with optional permission assignments.

**Required permission:** `role.create`

weight.description: Numeric priority weight for the role

permissions.description: Permission IDs to assign to this role

get.description:
Returns a single role with its permissions.

**Required permission:** `role.view`

put.description:
Updates an existing role and its permission assignments.

**Required permission:** `role.update`

permissions.description: Permission IDs to assign to this role

get.description:
Returns a list of all available permissions.

**Required middleware:** `auth:sanctum`

post.description:
Creates a new booking for a resource and activity in a specific time slot.

**Required permission:** `booking.create`

resource_id.description: Must exist in the resources table

activity_id.description: Must exist in the activities table

post.description:
Uploads the authenticated user's profile picture and returns a public URL.

**Required permission:** `me.update`

get.description:
Returns a paginated list of bookings joined by the authenticated user.

**Required permission:** `me.booking.view`

parameters.name: filter[upcoming]
parameters.description: When truthy, only upcoming bookings are returned

get.description:
Returns one booking joined by the authenticated user.

post.summary: Invite a guest to a booking
post.description:
Creates a guest invitation for one of the authenticated user's bookings.

**Required permission:** `me.booking.view`

Submits scores for participants in one of the authenticated user's bookings.

**Required permission:** `me.booking.view`

get.description:
Returns preferred categories for the authenticated user.

**Required permission:** `me.view`

Returns a paginated list of user notifications. Supports mailbox and type filters and sorting.

**Required permission:** `me.view`

post.description:
Marks one notification as read for the authenticated user.

**Required permission:** `me.view`

delete.description:
Deletes one notification for the authenticated user.

**Required permission:** `me.view`

get.description:
Returns booking and XP progression statistics for the authenticated user.

**Required permission:** `me.view`

Returns city autocomplete suggestions from Google Places.

**Required permission:** `venue.view`

Returns location details for a Google Place ID.

**Required permission:** `venue.view`

post.description:
Accepts an invitation for a booking guest. Caller must own the booking guest and have permission `booking.create`.

**Required permission:** `booking.create`

Declines an invitation for a booking guest. Caller must own the booking guest and have permission `booking.create`.

**Required permission:** `booking.create`

Returns a paginated list of bug reports. Supports message filtering and sorting by created date.

**Required permission:** `bug-report.view`

Creates a new bug report for the authenticated user.

**Required permission:** `bug-report.create`
